srch.title: Searches
srch.sub: What shoppers search for on the shop, and what found nothing — words only, never who searched.
srch.off: Off: searches are not counted. Switch "Count what shoppers search for" on under More options, and the words start to appear here from the next search.

missing.title: Found nothing
missing.sub: Words shoppers looked for that found no product: a style to stock, or a word to add to the search words.
missing.none: No search found nothing in this period.

top.title: Most searched
top.sub: The words searched most in this period.
top.none: No search counted in this period yet.

srch.note: A word is lower-cased and cut at 40 characters. Words that look like a phone number, an order number or an e-mail are never kept. Nothing is deleted.

set.d: Each search on the results page adds one to its words for the day; words only.
set.keepHelp: Off as shipped. While off, nothing is counted.
set.daysHelp: The longest period this report offers (7 to 365).
set.rowsHelp: How many words each list shows (5 to 200).
set.readOnly: You can see this card; changing it needs "Change settings".

err.STALE: Someone else changed this card. It has been read again.
err.INVALID_INPUT: A value is out of range.

pop.d: While you have chosen no popular words of your own, the empty search box shows the words searched most that found products. Needs "Count searches" on.
pop.on: Show popular words from real searches
pop.onHelp: Off as shipped. Your own list, when you write one, always wins.
pop.minHelp: A word found fewer times is not shown (1 to 100).
